launch_doors._comment: How a worker is reached, per runtime. Two doors: a subagent inside the current CLI, and a headless CLI started from bash with a given model. 'verified' lines were run once on the date shown (ticket 1063/1064 logs); 'unverified' lines were not run and are not to be trusted until they are.

subagent.form: Agent tool with a per-launch model token (haiku|sonnet|opus|fable); Workflow agent() inherits the session model unless opts set otherwise
subagent.pin: Pin the model on EVERY launch. Harness agents/*.md carry no model: line (the former 'model: standard|strong' tokens returned HTTP 404 and were removed, ticket 1063). An unpinned general-purpose launch inherits the session model.

headless.host_config: sealed by --restricted, not --safe-mode (--help 2.1.314): --restricted ignores the user, project and local settings files, so ~/.claude/settings.json (effortLevel low, per-model modelSettings) never reaches a seat; --safe-mode alone still loads them. The door pins every setting a seat needs: model, --effort medium (ticket 1371: unpinned, the seat ran at whatever default the CLI chose), tools by seat_rails. Not --bare: it skips the subscription login. Remaining host inputs: managed (policy) settings, ~/.claude.json account state, and the caller's environment, which gaze_seat.py replaces by an allowlist (ticket 1376: BASE_ENV plus this door's env_keep; CLAUDE_* and the rest are dropped)

subagent.form: Pi core has no subagents; the example extension examples/extensions/subagent spawns 'pi --mode json -p --no-session --model <agent.model>' (scripts/pi-subagent-link installs a patched copy whose flag is --session-dir <archive spool>, ticket 1383) with no model flag when the agent file pins none: since PR #2189 (ticket 1426) no Pi agent rendering pins a `model:`, so an unpinned child takes the dispatcher's model; only a hand-written agent file with a `model:` line pins one (per agent file, not per call). On padme the two symlinks in ~/.pi/agent/extensions/subagent/ were dangling (old node path) and were repointed to ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.1.0/... on 2026-10-08; scripts/pi-subagent-link re-points them from ~/.pi/agent/install/current-version and pi-haiku runs it at every start, so a Pi upgrade does not break them. Agent definitions live in ~/.pi/agent/agents/; haiku-scout.md pins anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 and needs the pi-haiku wrapper for the key.

headless.host_config: not sealed, pinned instead: the door passes its seat settings as flags (model, base URL, ask mode, no git; aider takes no effort setting here) (command-line flags beat config files), --env-file /dev/null drops ~/.env, and the scratch cwd keeps the reviewed tree's .aider.conf.yml out. Remaining host input: aider still searches ~/.aider.conf.yml and ~/.aider.model.settings.yml for keys the door does not set (none exist on padme, 2026-10-30)
headless.base_url_source: providers.<provider>.baseUrl in $IDH_PI_MODELS, else ~/.pi/agent/models.json (Pi's declaration, never a second copy). The model is pinned as <provider>/<id>; aider is run as openai/<id>. gaze_seat.py lists <baseUrl>/models first and refuses an id the server does not serve: a local server answers with whatever it has loaded, which is how Pi mislabelled a seat (ticket 1262).
headless.note: A local provider (name matches local_providers AND declared host is loopback, private or CGNAT) spends nothing, so it needs no cross-family consent. Its seat's family is the grid family of the served model id (gaze_seat.grid_family), else unknown: being local is access, not a family. Any other provider declared in Pi's file still needs consent. aider runs in an empty scratch directory outside the tree and any repo, because it loads .aider.conf.yml from its cwd and git root (a planted config can run commands); its report is the text after answer_marker when aider prints one (reasoning models), else the output after the leading banner (plain models); thinking without an answer marker is a truncated run and yields no report, so banner and thinking never reach the verdict scan. The api key is the literal 'local': padme's server ignores it.

headless.seat_rails_status: verified 2026-10-27 on Vibe 2.26.0 (ticket 1279): in -p, --enabled-tools disables every other tool; with only read_file a seat told to write tried write_file, bash and others and no file landed. grep is not offered: in the Unified Harness it runs through bash and is denied, the seat falls back to read_file. Stdin must be closed (gaze_seat.py gives /dev/null): an inherited stdin makes vibe -p block and print nothing. --output-dir <spool> (vibe --help 2.26.0, 2026-10-31, ticket 1383) copies the session journal and export.json to the per-seat archive spool on exit; the SIGKILL of a timed-out seat (seat_clock) loses that copy, and such a seat files no report.
headless.host_config: sealed by the disposable VIBE_HOME gaze_seat.py writes per seat: the host ~/.vibe config, trusted folders and agents never load; auth is the OS keyring
headless.note: No model flag: gaze_seat.py writes agents/seat.toml (active_model plus one [[models]]) into a disposable VIBE_HOME and removes it after the run; the pin reaches the API (a bogus id gets HTTP 400 Invalid model). Attribute the seat by the pin: the model misreports itself (said Claude 3.5 Sonnet). Auth is the Le Chat plan login in the OS keyring, no MISTRAL_API_KEY; whether pinned non-default models bill the plan or separately is unchecked (Mistral console). Vibe's default model is mistral-vibe-cli-latest (alias mistral-medium-3.5). The cwd is the review tree and stays untrusted (no --trust), so project config and AGENTS.md are not loaded. Supersedes the 2.25.8 finding (tickets 1017, 1279) that headless sessions deny file tools: that symptom was the stdin hang.
